headline: Norse Atlantic Airways files for bankruptcy and cancels all future flights
summary: Norse Atlantic Airways has filed for bankruptcy and cancelled all future flights after surging fuel costs caused by the Iran war ruined its finances. The Norwegian airline entered insolvency and instructed customers not to come to airports.
why: Airline bankruptcies disrupt travel markets and supply chains, while high jet fuel costs impact carrier operating margins globally.

impacts.name: Norse Atlantic Airways
impacts.why: The company has filed for bankruptcy and ceased operations.
